verdict.rationale: Greptile runs autonomously in the background on every pull request. The docs show configurable review triggers, a greptile.json file for behavior, automatic test generation and diagrams, TREX sandbox runtime testing that posts artifacts to the PR, and API-key CLI use in CI. A user report confirms automatic PR reviews in practice. However, these automations are limited to the PR-review pipeline, not general user-defined background automations. Missing for 10: general-purpose automation authoring (custom schedules or triggers beyond PR events, arbitrary workflows), autonomous background fixing without a human clicking Fix or running a loop, and independent corroboration beyond one user comment.
